reason: They look like a decent price, but I don't know this seller and there are no reviews. I'd be handing over £300 in cash or a bank transfer to a stranger for wheels I drive on every day.
objection: Refurbished wheels might peel or fail again, and with a new seller and no reviews I have nothing to go on. The 7-day return only covers wheels returned unmarked, so once they're fitted I couldn't really send them back.
would_change_my_mind: Photos of the actual set I'd get, a few real reviews from local customers, and a written guarantee against peeling or cracking for at least 12 months. Paying by card, or seeing them in person before I pay, would help too.
